name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: HBD checkbox: native <input type=checkbox> visually hidden (clip technique) behind a CSS-drawn .hbd-checkbox__control box with a brutalist offset shadow (--hbd-checkbox-shadow*). Controlled-first (checked + onCheckedChange, defaultChecked uncontrolled fallback) with checked, indeterminate (mixed dash), disabled, and error states. Carries the WC ARIA exactly: aria-describedby links hint + error spans, aria-invalid/aria-required on the input, role=alert on the error message.
